description: Header file defining classes and structures for managing broken HTTP alternative services, including tracking, expiration, and network context handling.

classes.name: BrokenAlternativeService
classes.description: Represents a broken alternative service with associated network context.

classes.name: RecentlyBrokenAlternativeServices
classes.description: LRU cache tracking how many times an alternative service has been marked broken.

classes.name: BrokenAlternativeServices
classes.description: Manages broken alternative services, their expiration, and network context, including marking, confirming, and expiration handling.

classes.name: BrokenAlternativeServices::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for notification when a broken alternative service expires.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeService
methods.description: Constructor initializing a broken alternative service with network context.

methods.name: RecentlyBrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Constructor for the LRU cache of broken service counts.

methods.name: BrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Constructor for managing broken services with delegate and clock.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all broken and recently broken services.

methods.name: MarkBrokenUntilDefaultNetworkChanges
methods.description: Marks a service as broken until network change.

methods.name: MarkBroken
methods.description: Marks a service as broken with expiration delay.

methods.name: MarkRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Marks a service as recently broken.

methods.name: IsBroken
methods.description: Checks if a service is considered broken.

methods.name: IsBroken (overload)
methods.description: Checks if a service is broken and retrieves expiration time.

methods.name: WasRecentlyBroken
methods.description: Checks if a service was recently marked broken.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Marks a service as working again.

methods.name: OnDefaultNetworkChanged
methods.description: Updates broken services on network change.

methods.name: SetBrokenAndRecentlyBrokenAlternativeServices
methods.description: Sets initial broken and recently broken services.

methods.name: SetDelayParams
methods.description: Configures delay parameters for broken services.
